verdict.rationale: CrewAI's API reference lists a `POST /resume` endpoint to "Resume crew execution with human feedback," alongside kickoff and status endpoints. That implies a pause-for-human-feedback-and-resume cycle, but only for deployed crews and only as a one-line API listing. A competitor founder says CrewAI lacks pausable agents, but that is an unverified competitor opinion, not a hands-on failure, so it does not make this disputed. missing for 10: in-framework docs on pausing an agent mid-run for human input or approval, how the human's decision is passed back into the agent's reasoning, approval-gate semantics, open-source (non-hosted) support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
